ruling: follows round 521: the briefing says the TTE conflation check cannot be done because nothing was obtained, and one record is in fact in hand. What that record is, is retrievable; whether it suffices is not.
population: acquired records in the S3-tte stratum, drawn plus accepted backfill
criterion: manifest status acquired; facts read from the manifest and the sections document, verification borrowed from the production verifier

whatThisDoesNotSay: Whether one record can support the check S3 was designed to run. That is a reading and a judgement, and n+147 reserves it away from the acquisition end.
whyItHelps: Nothing obtained and one record with these properties are different decision situations: the first can only be bought, the second can be looked at first. Choosing between them is not this room's call.
coverageStatement: Facts about the artifact, not about its contents. No title, abstract or section name is recorded.
contentNote: Id tails, counts, version and licence codes, host names.
